name: vigil
promptTemplate: A cathedral of darkness illuminated by {{flame_palette}} candlelight with {{wax_style}} wax pillars, dancing in a {{draft_intensity}} breeze with {{ember_density}} floating sparks and {{collective_bloom}} resonance.

ui.title: VIGIL // ALTAR
ui.tagline: A shared sanctuary of flickering candlelight

flame_palette.hint: Shift flame hues across the obsidian floor

draft_intensity.hint: Stirs the candle flames and ember drift

ember_density.hint: Volume of glowing sparks rising into darkness

collective_bloom.hint: Resonant glow when many shield their flames together

shield.hint: Cupping your flame makes it burn intensely

breathe.hint: Send a sudden gust rippling across all candles

listing.blurb: Candles flicker across a dark floor for everyone in the room; shielding your flame flares it bright, stirring collective warmth and dancing embers.
listing.prompt: A candlelight gathering: a candle for every person in the room, warm flames flickering on a dark ground; anyone can shield their candle, making it flare brighter, and when many do at once the whole field glows. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
